title: Covered Electrodes for Manual Metal Arc Welding of Carbon and Carbon Manganese Steel
qco_name: Welding Wires and Electrodes (Quality Control) Order
source_authority: Bureau of Indian Standards / Ministry of Steel

clauses.title: All-Weld Metal Tensile and Yield Strength Requirements
clauses.text: Clause 5.1 & Table 3: Deposited weld metal for classification E41 shall exhibit minimum yield strength of 330 MPa, tensile strength between 410 and 510 MPa, and minimum elongation of 22 percent on gauge length 5.65√So.

clauses.title: Charpy V-Notch Impact Toughness Test at Sub-Zero Temperatures
clauses.text: Clause 6.3: Charpy V-notch impact energy absorption shall not be less than 47 Joules at test temperature of 0°C (and 27 Joules at -20°C for sub-zero grade electrodes) to prevent brittle fracture in bridges and pressure vessels.
